focus: Angle 1 of 10, repo-bound inventory: which .skilled/, .opencode/ and .github/ references does the quality packet hold, and is each portable, configurable or repo-bound?
answeredQuestions: Which repo-bound assumptions does sk-code-quality hold, and how should each be removed, made configurable or isolated so the mode works in a repository without this framework's layout?

label: [OBSERVED] The quality mode maps .skilled skills, agents and commands to sibling authoring checklists, and maps .opencode/specs to system-spec-kit. Its live comment enforcement also names Claude settings, the .skilled Git hook installer and a GitHub Actions workflow. These are host and repository integrations; keep them in optional adapters around the shared quality rules.
